generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

itemList.description: Demolishing cement concrete manually/ by mechanical means including disposal of material

Removing & Resetting existing Heavy Duty Cobble/Interlocking stones/Pavers of thickness 60/75/80/100mm using Cement and 40mm thick sand bed ( average thickness ) and compacting with plate vibrator to achieve final desired compaction & setting of paver to its final level , including cost of materials, labour and tools, and accessories, complete in all respects as per the specifications and directions of the Engineer-in-Charge
Removing and resetting of precast kerb stones fixed with CM1:3 fixed and finished in line as per direction

Earth work excavation by manual means for foundation of Buildings & Bridges and such similar works in all kinds of soils , as per drawingand technical specifications, including setting out,shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, removalof stumps and other deleterious matter, excavated surface leveled and sides neatly dressed disposing offthe excavated stuff or sorting & stacking the selectedstuff for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5m including cost of labour, tools & other appurtenaces required to complete the work . (In all kinds of soils Depth upto 1.5 m)

Providing and laying in position plain cement concrete for levelling course for all works in foundation. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machineries, curing, and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. (The cost of steel reinforcement & formwork shall be paid separately) Mix 1:3:6 Using 40 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates

Filling available excavated earth (excluding rock) in trenches, plinth, sides of foundations and other similar works etc. in layers not exceeding 20cm in depth, consolidating each deposited layer by ramming and watering, lead up to 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m.

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for all foundation works. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers laid in layers, well compacted using needle vibrators. The cost includes all lead & lifts, cost of all materials, quality confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes , labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. 2.5.2 M30 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates.

Providing and removing centering, shuttering, strutting, propping etc ., Formwork shall be designed for rigidity, durability, strength, water tightness, easy deshuttering etc. Formwork designed with the proposed material (approved prior to making) shall be able to withstand its shape, line, dimensions, level within the allowable tolerences. Only steel jacks and steel spans shall be used. Bracing in both directions as specified by the structural engineer shall be provided. Necessary arrangements for providing camber as required shall be made. All necessary Sleeves / Cutouts / Inserts shall be left in position as per the relevant drawings before concreting. Formwork shall have adequate openings for cleaning. All slabs shall be progressively deshuttered and back propped as per instructions by structural engineer.
Shuttering below the shrinkage strip at every level shall be retained in place without disturbing for a time as specified by the Engineer In charge. PVC / Concrete cover blocks are permitted to be used. Slab concreting shuttering on sides shall be of Plywood shuttering sheets free of any impressions. vertical and horizontal surface such as walls, columns, slabs and beams, foundation & footings, pillars, piers, abutments, post and struts, square/ rectangular / polygon in plan such as walls at any thickness, including attached pilasters, buttresses, plinth cills and string courses, sides and soffits of plinth & Roof beams, beam haunchings, cantilever girders, bressummers and lintels, flat surface such as suspended floors, roofs, landings, balconies and likes, chejjas, staircase including landing. shall be done in plywood at all level and elevation.with all lead and lift and as directed by Engineer In charge(EIC).

Supplying, fitting and placing TMT FE 550 / 550D Steel Reinforcement including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, straightening,cutting, bending, hooking, aping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification a). Buildings.

Providing and fixing one set of Galvanised J-bolts along with washer and 3 galvanised nuts for each bolt and for each pedestal (Galvanised 8 Nos.), comprising 8 Nos. of J-bolts of 24 mm diameter and 850 mm length and 100 mm bend at the end. Each J-bolt shall be provided with a 40 mm diameter 3mm thick MS pipe sleeve of 300 mm depth. All J-bolts shall be welded together using MS rods to form a single assembly, as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge. The work shall include supply, fixing, positioning, levelling, cutting, welding, and all charges towards machinery, labour, tools, and accessories, including template 6mm thick complete in all respects as per the specifications, approved drawings, and directions of the Engineer-in-Charge.

Disposal of debris and surplus excavated earth by mechanical means using tractor, including loading, transportation, unloading, and spreading at the designated dumping area outside the ELCITA boundary, complete in all respects, as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge. ( Tractor Load)

Construction of chamber of inner size 600 x 600x 750 mm using 100 mm thick solid concrete blocks laid in cement mortar, including earthwork excavation, providing and laying PCC at the base, block masonry, plastering to internal and external surfaces, curing, and making good. Providing and fixing FRP chamber cover of approved make. Providing and fixing 75 mm diameter pipes (2 Nos.) inside the chamber and connecting the same to the nearby drain, including making necessary holes/openings in the chamber walls and drain, fixing, jointing, sealing with cement mortar, and making good the disturbed surfaces, complete in all respects with all labour, materials, tools, and plant, as per specifications and directions of the Engineer in Charge.

Providing and fixing PVC Long bend of 75 mm diameter of approved quality, including cutting, laying, jointing with solvent cement (PVC gum), fixing in position, testing, and making good the disturbed surfaces, complete in all respects, as per specifications and directions of the Engineer-in-Charge. ( 1.2 Mtr)

Providing and fixing PVC pipe of 75 mm diameter of approved quality, including bend, cutting, laying, jointing with solvent cement , fixing in position, testing, and making good the disturbed surfaces, complete in all respects, as per specifications and directions of the Engineer-in-Charge

Conducting total station survey at site for carrying out levelling, alignment, marking of points, and physical verification of site conditions, including detailed measurements as required. The scope shall include use of surveying instruments, deployment of qualified personnel, preparation of necessary field data/records, and submission of survey details to the Engineer-in-Charge. The item includes all supporting helper, tools, instruments, conveyance, trasportation and incidental charges, complete in all respects, as per directions of the Engineer-in-Charge.

Providing and applying 18 mm thick cement plaster in cement mortar 1:4 (1 cement : 4 coarse sand) on masonry/concrete surfaces, including raking out joints, cleaning the surface, wetting, applying plaster in true line and level, finishing smooth, and curing for the required period, complete in all respects, as per specifications and directions of the Engineer-in-Charge.
